name: Baltic birch plywood (BB/BB)
notes: Void-free multi-ply birch; the standard sheet stock for laser-cut and CNC-routed joinery. Nominal thickness runs under size and varies batch to batch by roughly +/-0.3 mm, so drive every slot and finger width from one project-global sheet-thickness parameter and MEASURE the actual sheet before cutting a whole design. Laser kerf is about 0.15-0.25 mm per side at 6 mm; a 3 mm router bit removes its full width, so kerf compensation direction is opposite between the two processes. Edges char under laser cutting and want light sanding. Glue face-grain to face-grain with PVA for laminations; end-grain screwing splits.
cost_hint: mid; sold in 1525 x 1525 mm or 2500 x 1250 mm sheets
sources: published nominal density range for birch plywood, 650-700 kg/m^3
